parsed.rationale: All three type-alias-objects — `PlaybackBlendModeKey` (PlaybackBlendMode.swift:89), `MaterialBlendModeKey` (MaterialBlendMode.swift:89), and `OverlayBlendModeKey` (_Plant_OverlayBlendMode.swift:89) — are exact duplicates at line 89 of their respective files within the same `Wallpaper` package, sharing `shared_field_count: 1` and no differing slots. Because they differ only in the blend-mode domain they tag, a single generic `BlendModeKey<Mode>` type parameterised on the concrete mode type would eliminate all three duplicates while preserving type safety. All three files are production code (all context flags false), so there is no intentional-duplication reason to avoid consolidation.
